'''Charles Hickey She Loves Me...She Loves Me Not''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on Decipher Deck Designs.

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Charles Hickey]]
* '''Published:''' February 2000 (Decipher Deck Designs)
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|You Can Either Profit By This...|EJP-L-youcaneitherprofitbythis.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' She Loves Me...She Loves Me Not
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PEndor She Loves Me...She Loves Me Not H.txt |Download]]

== Strategy ==

Light Side Enhanced Jabba's Palace Deck

Charles Hickey took this Light Side deck based on the new Enhanced Jabba's Palace objective, You Can Either Profit By This... / Or Be Destroyed to the Seattle GrandSlam. He played it to perfection, for a record of 4 wins and no losses during the preliminary rounds.

Give it a go! But this much red may take a little practise! So slip into the mind of a deck-builder for this tour of tech as Leia tells Han that Somebody Loves You...

== Strategy ==

Some card strategy first. With the two Docking Bays, and Jabba's Palace, I can either get to an operative planet (or off planet if needed), and also have 3 sites in a row for Fallen Portal. This site selection is also good with the Order to Engage + Narrow Escape combo.

Example: You battle to avoid losing 3 to Order To Engage. So I crush two characters with the Portal, then run away.

Ben Kenobi is included because he keeps Han alive after release. Very important. Master Luke combines with a good high destiny average, to bounce many aliens. Very nifty, especially against operatives. Boussh is the main rescue engine, used with the interrupt Someone Who Loves You. After rescue operations are complete, give her Leia's Blaster Rifle. Boussh is the best Leia ever!

The thinking behind other character selections reasonably easy.. Tamteel and Chewie, for the added lose 1 on Or Be Destroyed. Orimarrko for Narrow Escape and added force loss. And remember that those aliens help out your You Will Take Me To Jabba Now.

You may have noticed that there are a host of interrupts and effects By using weapons in the deck, I'm packing Weapon Levitation, plus I can steal a particular little girls saber. I have the Clash Of Sabers to break up some combo action, and cancel Presence Of The Force or You are beaten.

Ahhh, Fallen Portal, what a good card. I think this is one of two key cards to the strategy. It allows me to smash people and creatures when they least expect it!. Narrow Escape is the other key card, leading into the combo we described before which shows the fine art of hit and run!

Blaster Deflection can help keep Ben alive! I also have typical Hunt Down protection, and some nifty battle and search cards. Double Agent is for Mara. That's 35 cards destiny 3 or above!.

Meditation is awesome with Leia and her blaster rifle (shot is at +4, and opponent is immediately lost). Mechanical Failure to help deal with walkers, and No Disintegration's to deal with Bounty Hunters. Disarmed was a late edition to the deck, but it was played in 3 of 4 games at the GrandSlam.
